atoms.b: A word family is a group of words that share a common ((++root_word suffix)).
For example, the 'help' word family contains words such as ((++helper yelper)), ((++helpful beautiful)) and ((++helpless clueless)).
Spotting the root word can make it ((++easier harder)) to spell new words from that word family and to work out what they might mean.
